items.title: Moderna (MRNA) Lands March 2027 PBAC Slot For mRNA Flu Vaccine Listings
items.summary: Moderna (NasdaqGS:MRNA) has secured a March 2027 Pharmaceutical Benefits Advisory Committee agenda slot for its mRNA flu vaccines. The company is seeking National Immunisation Program listings that would bring public funding support for its seasonal flu mRNA products. The PBAC review in March 2027 will assess clinical evidence and cost effectiveness for potential government backed use of these vaccines.
